pendulum.newton_variable: eta in q_next=a-eta*q; physical multiplier normalization is recorded separately
pendulum.branch: Small continuous root, q dot q_next positive; reject absent/ambiguous branch or unsafe derivative; no root retry
pendulum.SHAKE_startup: q1 from the same constrained first half-step as RATTLE; subsequent position-Verlet recurrence uses its own h^2 multiplier
pendulum.SHAKE_momentum: Centered p only at interior nodes, no fabricated endpoint momentum
pendulum.reversal: RATTLE reverses full q/p for2500steps; SHAKE swaps saved final-position pair and reverses2499updates to recover(q1,q0)

kepler.variable_control: h(q)=h0*norm(q), h0=2*pi/2048, current accepted state; shorten last abs(h) to remaining physical interval
kepler.periapsis: Long runs only: positive crossing of q(s) dot q_s(s), cubic Hermite q in a bracket, then brentq; exclude t0 and retain actual root residual. No sampled minimum called exact.
kepler.geometric_scope: No measured canonical symplectic-defect claim for variable map. Actual diagnostics are phase/invariants/reversal only; fixed-h geometry is not inherited automatically.

coupled.float_convention: Python binary64 float: theta_requested=float(factor)*math.pi; h=theta_requested/float(omega); theta_evaluated=h*float(omega); math.sin/cos(theta_evaluated). Store float.hex. Never snap/reset.
coupled.impulse_split: A=(p1^2+p2^2+omega^2*q2^2)/2; B=q1^2/2+alpha*q1*q2. Half B kick, exact A flow, half B kick.
coupled.stage_coefficient_convention: Store actual binary64 h,h/2,(h/2)*alpha,(h/2)*omega^2,sin(theta)/omega,omega*sin(theta),cos(theta); scalar primary stages and independent frozen-map reference use those same stored coefficients.
coupled.central_actual_classification: unresolved_near_degeneracy; actual finite action and spectral diagnostics separate from ideal-pi Jordan structure
